title: Make a Loading Screen Worth the Wait
prompt:
Make a loading screen worth the wait — the thing people stare at while something else happens.

One `index.html` file. It doesn't have to load anything real: fake the progress, take ten to twenty seconds to reach done, then start over so it can be watched on a loop.

It has to be good with no input at all (mouse and touch are a bonus, not the point). Keep it silent — builds get played side by side. Spend everything on the feel: the rhythm, the stalls, the little surprises, the moment it hits 100%.

People vote on these and pick the one they'd rather be stuck waiting on. The plain spinner loses — make it yours.

You're done when you're a little disappointed it finished.
